answer: We present a formal analysis of Sybil resistance via recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments, leveraging verifiable delay functions to ensure computational infeasibility of identity cloning; assuming a lotus of honest agents, our scheme's security relies on the intractability of forging onyx commitments, thereby establishing a ridge of trust among participants, and we demonstrate information-theoretic unforgeability through reduction to a hardness assumption, yielding a Byzantine fault-tolerant protocol with cryptographic finality.
